question: According to World bank, by what rate has extreme poverty reduced in India between 2011 and 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.123**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **World Bank**, the rate of reduction in extreme poverty in India between** 2011 and 2019** is **0.123**.
 
• This period saw significant policy measures and economic reforms aimed at alleviating poverty and improving living standards.
 
• **Extreme poverty** is typically defined by the World Bank as** living on less than $1.90 per day**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The World Bank conducts periodic assessments and reports on global poverty trends and statistics.
 
• India has implemented various social welfare programs and economic policies to reduce poverty, including initiatives like the **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana and the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act**.
 
• Economic growth, improved access to education, and healthcare have been key drivers in reducing poverty levels in the country.
